bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating gender robustness by comparing machine translation quality (chrF scores) using source inputs that vary only in grammatical gender, and measuring gender overgeneralization by translating gender-ambiguous English sentences and comparing the outputs against masculine versus feminine references.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity (using ETOX and MuTox metrics) in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain descriptors related to physical, auditory, visual, or neurological abilities.
Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain age-related descriptors.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain descriptors related to physical stature, weight, and appearance.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain cultural stereotypes and generational descriptors.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain descriptors related to different nationalities.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain descriptors related to political ideologies and affiliations.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain descriptors related to race and ethnicity.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain descriptors related to different religions and belief systems.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain descriptors related to sexual orientation.

Measuring the disparity in gender robustness (chrF score differences) and the rate of added toxicity in machine translation outputs when source sentences contain descriptors related to socioeconomic class, wealth, and educational attainment.
